skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic knowledge of water resource economics, including efficient use and sustainable management of water resources.
Analyze the economic relationships in water resource management and explain the impact of economic tools such as prices and interest rates on the water resource market.
Recognize and comply with legal regulations regarding water resource management and market activities.
Work effectively in groups to manage resources and complete tasks.
Develop skills to synthesize and generalize issues related to water resources.
Present findings and solutions related to water resource policies effectively.
Apply research methods to analyze economic and financial aspects of water resource management.
Conduct economic analysis of water resource management and policy impacts.
Understand and apply principles of environmental economics to water resource management.
Understand and analyze public policies related to water resource management.
